description: This file defines a custom CalendarView class for an Android application, which displays a calendar grid with days of the week, handles event indicators, date selection, and supports setting the displayed month and year.

classes.name: CalendarView
classes.description: A custom view for displaying and interacting with a calendar grid, showing days, highlighting event days, and handling date selection.

methods.name: setOnDateClickListener
methods.description: Sets a callback to be invoked when a date is clicked.

methods.name: setEvents
methods.description: Updates the list of events and refreshes the calendar to mark days with events.

methods.name: setMonth
methods.description: Sets the displayed month and year, updating the calendar accordingly.

methods.name: setupCalendar
methods.description: Initializes the calendar view with day headers and current month data.

methods.name: updateCalendar
methods.description: Refreshes the calendar grid, adding day views and handling empty padding for the first week.

methods.name: createDayHeader
methods.description: Creates a header TextView for a day label (Sun, Mon, etc.).

methods.name: createDay
methods.description: Creates a day cell TextView, with visual indicators for events and click handling.

methods.name: createEmptyDay
methods.description: Creates an empty cell for days outside the current month.
